summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Handoff: keep SearchWoot private and external outreach unsent. Woot materials establish API access mechanics but not public or commercial reuse rights; all four launch-readiness tasks remain open. Continue the consolidated evidence bundle and counsel review only.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external outreach unsent, and authorize only bounded read-only evidence work. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate, advertising, alert-expansion, or public-display decision. Evidence: official API materials establish access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, retain history, send alerts, use images/trademarks/prices, or monetize. Current compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable; ROI, margin, and payback remain unsupported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable because available evidence is partial. Open tasks: source rights; alert-data flow and retention; GA4 consent and configuration; logs, vendors, and incident handling. Progress is limited to existing API, terms, support, repository, privacy, and cookie-policy evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted caching, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps. No data-use item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Compliance and claims triage: retain cookie and analytics disclosures, consent and withdrawal behavior, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, provenance and rights records, copyright and trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards where supported by site evidence. Do not infer adult or regulated status from domain names. Analytics source permission errors and yellow freshness/coverage status must remain unknown rather than zero; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and a completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization. No go-live proposal is supported.

Candidate-plan review: retain only the three evidence-backed opportunities as deferred backlog evidence; do not create proposals, change requests, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, spend, deployments, or monetization work this cycle. The fleet-normalization item is rejected pending a bounded evidence brief. Continue existing failure repair-or-close, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, and read-only legal/security evidence. Preserve aggregate affiliate revenue as unattributed and do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift from operating metrics.
